lines: Notice to travelers: the road ahead is crawling with the dead.
Use %%JUMP%% to clear gaps and traps, and press %%ATTACK%% to cut down anything that gets in your way.
Fire's hot and the anvil is waiting. Hand over your upgrade tokens if you want me to make you stronger.
Don't go out there with a dull edge. Let's see what we can upgrade.
Potions, gear, and whatever else I pulled off the last guy who went into the woods. Take a look.
Got coins to spend or junk to sell? Make it quick, I don't do refunds.
The stone hums softly. Your progress is carved into its memory.
Woof! *He wags his tail, happy to see someone who isn't a skeleton.*
*The dog sniffs your boots, probably hoping you dropped some food.*
Oh, good, someone who can actually hold a sword. I am Andellia. You have probably heard of my thesis on the sunken spire.
The other scholars were too terrified to leave the capital, so I had to map these save totems all by myself.
Honestly, nobody else has the intellect for it.
It took me three days to decode the runes on those stones, a feat my peers said would take a century.
They anchor your soul so the forest curse cannot hollow you out like the soldiers outside.
Try not to get killed out there. It would be a tragedy if nobody was left alive to appreciate my research.
Do make sure to use the save totems. I did not decipher their ancient magic just for you to ignore them!
Easy with that weapon! My eyes might glow, but I'm not one of those monsters.
I'm Anita. My scouting group got ambushed by ghouls just up ahead.
My wind magic can slow them down, but there are too many for me to take alone.
Help me clear them out, and I'll watch your back. What do you say?
Changed your mind? Those ghouls aren't going to clear themselves out. Ready to fight?
You have come far through the mist, warrior.
I am Roric. For years, my bow has kept the rot of these woods from spreading to the lands beyond.
If you want to pass, you have to prove your will won't break under the storm. Draw your weapon and survive my trial.
The storm fades, and you are still standing.
It has been a long time since I fought someone with your resolve.
My trial is over. Go on ahead, warrior. You have earned it.
Keep this between us, alright? Nikolas keeps telling everyone he fought off ten knights, but...
The barkeep saw him trip over a barrel running from a single skeleton.
Also, did you hear the blacksmith waters down his quenching oil?
People talk when they think I'm just staring at the floor under this hat.
Hey, has Eeryn said anything about me? I polished my katana three times today and stood by her table for an hour.
She looked right through me and asked the air for a refill. I think she's just playing hard to get. Definitely.
Word around the tavern is that Andellia got kicked out of the royal academy for bragging too much during a lecture.
Still, if I can find a rare flower out in the woods, maybe Eeryn will finally look at me for more than two seconds.
Stand back, citizen! You are looking at Nikolas, the greatest bladesman to ever walk these woods.
The guys in the tavern always burst out laughing when I say that.
It's nice to see my legendary reputation brings so much joy to the common folk!
I was about to defeat that Lancer myself, you know. Had her right where I wanted her.
Then I remembered I left my favorite lute string back at the tavern. It was a tactical retreat, no matter what Mitch tells you.
Dejanovic told me my fighting stance looks like a wet scarecrow.
Coming from a guy in full plate armor, I take that as a compliment on my flexibility!
Anyway, I'll let you handle the monsters today. Wouldn't want to hog all the glory.
I swore I wouldn't take this helmet off until the forest curse is broken.
Though I have to admit, drinking tavern ale through a steel visor takes a lot of practice.
Listening to Mitch brag by the fireplace is more exhausting than fighting wraiths.
At least the fire is warm in here. Rest your bones while you can, warrior.
Those armored knights roaming the ruins were once my sworn brothers.
Now they are just empty shells bound to a dead oath. If they block your path, give them a clean end.
Keep your shield ready out here. The undead knights hit hard, and the mist hides their approach.
Good armor will save your life when your reflexes fail.
My, you look strong. Listen, I accidentally dropped my favorite ruby ring at the bottom of a spike pit just east of here.
Why don't you jump right in and grab it for me? I promise there's no trap at the bottom. You can trust this smile, can't you?
People are so easy to read. Wave a little illusion in front of their eyes, tell them they're special, and they'll hand over their whole coin purse.
Speaking of pathetic, there is a man in a straw hat who keeps breathing loudly near my elbow.
Do you know if he is a coat rack, or can I pay you to shoo him away?
If you find any mythic relics out there, bring them straight to me.
They are terribly cursed and dangerous for a brute like you.
I will gladly take them off your hands for free, purely out of the goodness of my heart.
